standard-dialogue.npc: Hello. How can I help you?

steps.player: What are you selling?

options.text: Can you give me any Farming advice?

steps.player: Can you give me any Farming advice?

steps.npc: Yes - ask a gardener.

options.text: Can you tell me how to use the loom?

steps.player: Can you tell me how to use the loom?

steps.npc: Well, it's actually my loom, but I don't mind you using it, if you like. You can use it to weave sacks and baskets in which you can put vegetables and fruit.

options.text: What do I need to weave sacks?

steps.player: What do I need to weave sacks?

steps.npc: Well, the best sacks are made with jute fibres; you can grow jute yourself in a hops patch. I'd say about 4 jute fibres should be enough to weave a sack.

steps.player: Thank you, that's very kind.

options.text: What do I need to weave baskets?

steps.player: What do I need to weave baskets?

steps.npc: Well, the best baskets are made with young branches cut from a willow tree. You'll need a very young willow tree; otherwise, the branches will have grown too thick to be able to weave. I suggest growing your own.
You can cut the branches with a standard pair of secateurs. You will probably need about 6 willow branches to weave a complete basket.

steps.player: Thank you, that's very kind.
Thank you, that's very kind.
I'm okay, thank you.
I've come about the bounty.

steps.npc: Oh thank Saradomin! It's about time someone responded, something needs to be done!

steps.player: Can you explain what happened?

steps.npc: Of course. I was making my monthly delivery to The Sheared Ram in Lumbridge, heading east near the Draynor Village crossroads.
Suddenly, out of the trees came a hulking monster! It chased me for a short distance, but luckily Rosie managed to spook it enough to give me a headstart.

steps.player: Sounds like it must have given you quite the scare!

steps.npc: It certainly did. I even lost my cart full of farm produce!

options.text: What did the monster look like?

steps.player: What did this monster look like?

steps.npc: I didn't get a very good look at it I'm afraid. It was getting dark and as soon as I saw it charging at me, I ran.
I can still hear the sound, though. A horrible grunting... squealing...
Is there anything else you wanted?

options.text: Any tips on finding this thing?

steps.player: Any tips on finding this thing?

steps.npc: Tips...? You're supposed to be the professional monster slayer!
Although, I suppose a good place to start would be checking the area I was attacked. See if you can find the remains of my cart.

steps.player: Ok, yes that could work.

steps.npc: Is there anything else you wanted?

steps.player: Whereabouts were you attacked again?

steps.npc: I remember being somewhere near the crossroads, north of Draynor Village.
Sorry that I'm not much help. It happened so fast, the whole thing is a bit of a blur.

steps.player: That's okay. Crossroads north of Draynor... At least I have somewhere to start.

steps.npc: Is there anything else you wanted?

steps.player: You mentioned that Rosie spooked the monster. Who's that?

steps.npc: Oh, that'll be our lady over there by the fire. She's such a good dog, always accompanies me on deliveries.
You can pet her if you like. She's very friendly.
Is there anything else you wanted?

options.text: I think that'll be all for now.

steps.player: I think that'll be all for now.

steps.npc: Excellent! Best of luck to you, I'll be waiting right here with your reward.

steps.player: That monster certainly won't be troubling you from now on.

steps.npc: Oh that's fantastic news! I'm so relie-
Wait, how do I know you're not just saying that to get the bounty?

steps.player: How about this as proof?

steps.text: You pull the foot out of your backpack and show it to Sarah.

steps.npc: Eugh! Yes, that certainly looks about right!

steps.player: Indeed, the smell is... something quite special.

steps.npc: I'll probably just give it to the dog.
I'm glad you made it back. Some strange woman in a hood came asking about the job shortly after you left. I didn't really want her back in here.
Anyway, thank you so much! Here's your reward.

steps.text: Sarah hands you a heavy pouch of 5,000 coins.

steps.player: Perhaps I should speak with Spria and tell her that the monster's been dealt with.

treasure-trails-easy.text: If the reward is another clue scroll:
